identification: Kerosene table lamp, about 1890-1920: pale amber/honey glass font with horizontal ribbing (possibly sun-tinted or marigold-flashed, can't tell from photo), on a pierced cast iron pyramidal foot with scale and bead decoration, painted silver-white (worn, rust showing). Brass collar and small brass burner with prongs, plain clear glass chimney. Likely American import. Maker unknown. Cloud scan correct.
